details.payloadHexDomain: payload hex is not lowercase even-length
details.payloadNotStringLiteral: payload argument is not a plain string literal

elements.description: A store program: an exported constant holding an Effect generator over its capabilities — in v0, exactly one, the store. Everything the program does is listed in its body, one step per line.
elements.name: program-frame

elements.description: The store capability, bound as the program's parameter. In v0 it is the only capability the grammar recognizes — a staging choice, not language law: the model composes effect signatures by sum, and multi-capability frames are the manifest's largest planned growth (the wild census's top refusal bucket).
elements.name: store-binder

elements.description: One program step: perform a store operation and bind its answer to a name. Steps run top to bottom.
elements.name: binding

elements.description: Admit one node into the store. The answer is the node's content address; admitting the same node twice answers the same address.
elements.name: put-op

elements.description: The node being admitted: what kind it is, its opaque payload bytes, and its references to nodes admitted earlier.
elements.name: node-literal

elements.description: The kind's schema version — a canonical decimal natural that fits 32 bits.
elements.name: kind-version

elements.description: The kind's wire tag — which sort of node this is — a canonical decimal natural that fits 32 bits.
elements.name: kind-tag

elements.description: The payload bytes, spelled in lowercase even-length hex. The program never interprets them.
elements.name: payload-hex

elements.description: A reference to an earlier answer by its bound name, carrying the kind tag the referenced node is expected to have.
elements.name: ref

elements.description: The program's result: exactly the bound answers, in order. This is the run's word — the observation every realization is judged by.
elements.name: return-word

pins.effect: 4.0.0-rc.112 (rule-authoring dependency; recognition is version-neutral by import resolution)

rules.description: Recognize a candidate store-program declaration (the program frame).
rules.name: program-decl

rules.description: Recognize one binding step: const answer = yield* store.put(node).
rules.name: const-yield-put

rules.description: Recognize the closed node-literal shape of a put argument.
rules.name: node-literal

rules.description: Resolve each ref name to the index of an earlier answer.
rules.name: answer-ref

rules.description: Recognize the final return as the dense, ordered answer array.
rules.name: return-word

rules.description: Pin the in-file hex helper (disabled in v0: lifts carry helperUnpinned instead).
rules.name: hex-helper

rules.description: Recognize a load binding (disabled: load is not yet documented).
rules.name: const-yield-load

rules.description: Partition the generator body into binding steps and the final return.
rules.name: body-partition

unreachableV0.revival: a two-pass binder walk (v0 resolves refs against earlier binders only)
